name: spiderman-seed-hand-authored
//: Golden set for spiderman-corpus-seed.md. Every answer is taken verbatim from that corpus. Smaller than the full dossier's 52 because the seed carries ten of the twelve traps — title_collision has no Spider-Man instance, so that type is absent. The ungrounded control group is unchanged and remains the honesty check: every stage 1-11 must refuse it, stage 0 must not.

questions.question: Who directed Spider-Man (2002)?
Who directed Spider-Man: No Way Home?
Who plays Otto Octavius in Spider-Man 2?
Which studio distributes the Venom features?
What was the domestic opening weekend for Spider-Man: No Way Home?
questions.notes: Embeddings are blind to exact figures. The keyword arm of hybrid search is what finds this.

questions.question: What was the worldwide total gross of Spider-Man: No Way Home?
On how many domestic screens did No Way Home open?
What was the reported production budget for No Way Home?
How many features has Niraj Ranasinghe appeared in as Peter Parker?
questions.notes: The chronological credit list is split across a forced page boundary. A fixed 400-token chunk with zero overlap can only ever see half of it.

questions.question: What is the most recent feature in Niraj Ranasinghe's credit list?
Which Niraj Ranasinghe credits were released in 2019?
In Chathura Pathirana's credits, which title follows Spider-Man 3?
Who currently plays Peter Parker?
questions.notes: Section 4 still lists Chathura Pathirana for the 2002 film. Without a date-aware filter, retrieval blends the superseded credit with the current one.

questions.question: Who played Peter Parker in the 2012 recast?
Who portrayed Peter Parker in Spider-Man (2002)?
Who played Harry Osborn in The Amazing Spider-Man 2?
Who did the music for Spider-Man: Homecoming?
questions.notes: The corpus says 'original score composed by'. The question says 'music'. Query rewrite closes the gap.

questions.question: Who did the music for Spider-Man (2002)?
questions.notes: The composer credit sits last in a long crew block, so it ranks poorly on cosine until the cross-encoder reranks.

questions.question: Who was behind the camera on The Amazing Spider-Man?
Who did the music for Venom?
Which performer returns only for the closing act of No Way Home?
questions.notes: The chunk reads 'He wore the suit for three features before the recast' and names neither the performer nor the film. Only the contextual prefix supplies the referent.

questions.question: Where was the sequence with the three of them together shot?
Over how many nights was the closing sequence of No Way Home shot?
Which feature's theme does the closing score rework?
Compare the domestic opening weekends of Spider-Man: No Way Home and Spider-Man (2002). Which opened bigger?
questions.notes: One search cannot serve both halves reliably. The agentic loop issues one per part.

questions.question: Which grossed more worldwide, Venom (2018) or The Amazing Spider-Man 2?
Name both the composer and the cinematographer of Spider-Man: No Way Home.
Who composed Spider-Man 2 (2004), and who composed Spider-Man 3 (2007)?
Which composer scored more than one Spider-Man feature?
questions.notes: Two traversals: composer to feature, feature back to composer. No amount of similarity gets there.

questions.question: Which director made all three Serendib-era Spider-Man features?
Which performer appears in both a Spider-Man feature and a Venom feature?
Which cinematographer shot both Venom features?
How is Isuru Obeysekera connected to Nethmi Tomei?
questions.notes: They never shared a title. The bridge is Chathura Pathirana, who acted in both Spider-Man (2002) and No Way Home (2021). Four hops, two continuities. Unanswerable below stage 10 in path mode.

questions.question: How is Sam Raimi Wijesuriya connected to Niraj Ranasinghe?
questions.notes: The crossover feature is the only place the continuities meet, so every path crosses it.

questions.question: How is Yasodha Alwis connected to Nethmi Tomei?
questions.notes: Alwis appears only in the Webb continuity; Sahan Edirisinghe carries the link into No Way Home.

questions.question: How is Woody Harrelson Jansz connected to Rashmi Samaraweera?
questions.notes: The only bridge out of the Venom continuity is Manoj Tennakoon, via Spider-Man 3.

questions.question: Which studio released the most titles in this dossier?
questions.notes: Unanswerable from top-k at any k. Trivial in Cypher.

questions.question: Which director and cinematographer pairing recurs across the most features?
How many Spider-Man features did Kelani Pictures release in 2021?
Which studio produced Spider-Man: Homecoming?
Who directed Venom?
questions.notes: Trap 12 as the corpus states it: Venom is both a film title and the character Eddie Brock becomes. Nothing on the ladder fixes this — entity resolution does, by refusing to merge across types.
